name: set_variable_step @dry_run boolean coercion
description: No sender/recipient filtering. Exercises the documented pitfall in docs/workflow.md: '@dry_run' is a reserved control key checked as a Python truthy value elsewhere in the engine, so writing the literal string 'false' to it without value_type=boolean would leave dry-run ON (all non-empty strings are truthy). Here value_type=boolean coerces 'disable' to the real boolean False, so this workflow saves for real even when invoked via a dry-run entry point that would otherwise seed @dry_run=True into context before steps run. Use with example-data/emails/priority_ticket.eml.
